name: Ebola & haemorrhagic fevers
summary: Ebola in DR Congo passes 5,000 deaths, per the government; cases in Kenya and Nigeria
state: DR Congo's government reported more than 5,000 deaths and over 10,300 confirmed cases across eight provinces as of 2 Nov (Pulse Nigeria), up from WHO's count of 9,704 cases to 20 Oct. Kenya has nine cases, and Nigeria confirmed an imported case on 20 Oct and is testing two suspected cases. ECDC rates the risk to the general EU population as very low.
for_you: Risk in the UK is very low. Travellers to affected areas should follow FCDO, NaTHNaC and UKHSA guidance.
rubric_hit: More than 1,000 cases; spread to a new country within 30 days (Nigeria, 20 Oct) = Alert
basis_detail: WHO, Africa CDC and ECDC case counts
basis_by: WHO, Africa CDC and ECDC case counts

sources.title: Pulse Nigeria — DR Congo Ebola outbreak death toll exceeds 5,000
ECDC — Ebola disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, update 28 Oct

why: Ebola, Marburg and similar viruses kill a large share of those infected; outbreaks that reach cities or cross borders can overwhelm health systems.
drivers: Surveillance and contact tracing, vaccine availability (none licensed for some strains), conflict, cross-border travel, health-worker infections.

rubric.alert: More than 1,000 cases, or spread to a new country in the past 30 days.
rubric.watch: An active outbreak contained within one country, or fewer than 1,000 cases.
rubric.normal: No active Ebola/Marburg outbreak, or outbreaks declining with no new countries affected in 60 days.
